title: This Claude Fable 5-Minute Scalping Bot is SO GOOD It's Almost Illegal
body: Claude Fable 5-min scalping bot, 5 simple strategies, all 5-minute timeframe, backtested vs buy-and-hold. STRATEGY 1 (momentum breakout + volatility filter): fast SMA above slow SMA; close higher than close of past 20 bars (20-bar breakout); only green candles (close>open); entry at candle open; stop 1.5%, take-profit 3%. Backtest +196%, max DD 12%, 44% win, profit factor 1.8. STRATEGY 2 (SMA crossover): SMA50 above SMA100; stop 1%, TP 2%. +103%, DD 11%, 534 trades, PF 1.614. STRATEGY 3 (EMA/SMA + Z-score): EMA10 above SMA50; close above close 20 bars ago; Z-score <= 2 where Z=(close-SMA20)/std20; stop 1.7%, TP 3%. +103%, DD 16%, 599 trades, PF 1.224, Sharpe below 1. STRATEGY 4 (trend breakout, SMA body-fraction): SMA body fraction length 10 above 0.1; recent candles not wicky; close above SMA100; close above close 20 bars ago; stop 1.5%, TP 3%. +1156% but max DD 60% (unusable). STRATEGY 5 (VWMA buy-the-dip mean reversion, long only): price below lower Bollinger band -> buy the dip (single order); VWMA trend filter; stop 1%, TP 2%. +5381%, max DD 47%, 72% win, PF 1.252. He admits entries are cherry-picked and high-DD ones unusable. Uses a 'Trader Dev / DaviddTech' MCP backtesting server (87,000 community backtests, 32,000 strategies) installed into Claude Code, with a LOOP function to sweep settings = automated backtesting, then gives base strategies to AI (Fable 5 / Opus 4.8) to improve. Crypto + cherry-picked; modest profit factors; Sharpe admittedly under 1.
